Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
fix: Add --yes flag to skip confirmation prompt in update script

ISSUE: Update button was failing with "Data update failed" error
ROOT CAUSE: update_recent_data.py had interactive input\(\) prompt
- When run from web dashboard via subprocess, no stdin available
- Caused EOFError: "EOF when reading a line"
- Update endpoint returned 500 error

SOLUTION:
1. tools/update_recent_data.py:
   - Added auto_confirm parameter to update_recent_data\(\)
   - Added --yes/-y command line flag
   - Skip confirmation prompt when auto_confirm=True
   - Print "Auto-confirmed: Starting update..." instead

2. web_dashboard.py:
   - Updated /api/update endpoint to pass --yes flag
   - Changed: [''python'', ''tools/update_recent_data.py'', ''--days'', ''5'']
   - To: [venv_python, ''tools/update_recent_data.py'', ''--days'', ''5'', ''--yes'']

TESTING:
✓ Manual test: python tools/update_recent_data.py --days 5 --yes
✓ Successfully bypasses confirmation prompt
✓ Begins downloading data immediately
✓ Works in automated/subprocess contexts

BENEFITS:
- Update button in web dashboard now functional
- No user interaction needed for scheduled/automated updates
- Backward compatible \(still prompts without --yes flag\)
- Safer for background processes
